from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial layout setup
        title = "The Gatekeeper: Activation Functions"
        lines = [
            "Activation functions decide if the signal should pass through.",
            "They introduce non-linearity, allowing for complex pattern recognition.",
            "ReLU squashes negative values to zero and keeps positive ones."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_CURVE = "#00BFFF"
        COLOR_GATE = "#FF4500"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Activation functions decide if the signal should pass through.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(COLOR_CURVE))
        
        # Setup Axes on the right side
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-3, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 3, 1],
            x_length=4.5,
            y_length=4.5,
            axis_config={"color": WHITE, "include_tip": True}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B2", "E6")
        
        # Linear graph initially
        linear_graph = axes.plot(lambda x: x, color=COLOR_CURVE, x_range=[-3, 3])
        linear_label = MathTex("y = x", color=COLOR_CURVE, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(linear_label, "B5")

        self.play(Create(axes), Create(linear_graph))
        self.play(Write(linear_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # They introduce non-linearity, allowing for complex pattern recognition.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_CURVE))
        
        # Transform Linear to ReLU (hockey stick curve)
        relu_graph = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), color=COLOR_CURVE, x_range=[-3, 3])
        relu_label = MathTex("f(z) = \\max(0, z)", color=COLOR_CURVE, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(relu_label, "B5")

        self.play(
            Transform(linear_graph, relu_graph),
            Transform(linear_label, relu_label)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # ReLU squashes negative values to zero and keeps positive ones.
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_GATE))

        # Gatekeeper icon
        gate_body = RegularPolygon(n=8, color=COLOR_GATE, fill_opacity=0.6).scale(0.4)
        gate_text = Text("GATE", font_size=16, color=WHITE, weight=BOLD)
        gatekeeper = VGroup(gate_body, gate_text)
        self.place_at_grid(gatekeeper, "D1") # Placed near the negative x-axis

        self.play(FadeIn(gatekeeper, shift=RIGHT))

        # Signal (z value) being squashed
        z_tracker = ValueTracker(-2.5)
        
        # Input dot on the x-axis
        input_dot = Dot(color=WHITE, radius=0.08)
        input_dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(axes.c2p(z_tracker.get_value(), 0)))
        
        # Input value label
        z_label = MathTex("z =", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        z_val_num = DecimalNumber(z_tracker.get_value(), num_decimal_places=1, font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        z_display = VGroup(z_label, z_val_num).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        z_display.add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(input_dot, UP, buff=0.2))
        
        # Output dot on the curve
        output_dot = Dot(color=COLOR_CURVE, radius=0.08)
        output_dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(axes.c2p(z_tracker.get_value(), max(0, z_tracker.get_value()))))
        
        # Connecting lines (updaters for performance)
        v_line = Line(color=WHITE, stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.5)
        v_line.add_updater(lambda l: l.set_points_as_corners([
            axes.c2p(z_tracker.get_value(), 0), 
            axes.c2p(z_tracker.get_value(), max(0, z_tracker.get_value()))
        ]))

        h_line = Line(color=COLOR_CURVE, stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.5)
        h_line.add_updater(lambda l: l.set_points_as_corners([
            axes.c2p(z_tracker.get_value(), max(0, z_tracker.get_value())),
            axes.c2p(0, max(0, z_tracker.get_value()))
        ]))

        # Add tracking elements
        self.add(input_dot, z_display, output_dot, v_line, h_line)

        # Show blocking for negative values
        blocking_indicator = Cross(gatekeeper, stroke_color=RED, stroke_width=6).scale(0.5)
        
        self.play(z_tracker.animate.set_value(-0.5), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(Create(blocking_indicator), Flash(gatekeeper, color=RED))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(blocking_indicator))

        # Show passing for positive values
        self.play(z_tracker.animate.set_value(2.0), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        
        # Final highlight of the squash
        squash_label = Text("Positive signals pass through!", font_size=18, color=COLOR_CURVE)
        self.place_at_grid(squash_label, "F4")
        self.play(Write(squash_label))
        
        self.wait(2)
